title: Choose the About page structure
question: Each direction keeps the Activity Ledger visual system and the same factual story. Choose how the story should unfold.

options.label: The Working Dossier
options.lineage: The portfolio's clipped case files and analyst working papers
options.thesis: A personal case file that moves from present role to the questions behind the work.
options.viewport: A decisive opening statement leads into four compact evidence leaves: banking, technical pressure, software, and public work.
options.risk: It needs disciplined copy lengths so the dossier feels human, not bureaucratic.

options.label: The Decision Register
options.lineage: A dated investment memo translated into a public biography
options.thesis: The story reads as a sequence of decisions rather than a conventional biography.
options.viewport: A short lead is followed by numbered moments: finance context, recurring technical friction, building with code, and publishing the work.
options.risk: The sequence can feel too chronological if the entries lose their present-day relevance.

options.label: Double-Entry Biography
options.lineage: Bookkeeping columns recast as two sides of one practice
options.thesis: Finance and software run in parallel columns, then reconcile in Marc’s projects and writing.
options.viewport: Two equal rails compare what finance asks with what software makes testable before converging on Savyy, the blog, and contact.
options.risk: The metaphor must stay subtle or it can turn the person into an accounting diagram.
